# Nota

> Create a professional invoice PDF in the browser. No upload, no signup, no watermark.

The public origin is https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

Longer facts: https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Tools

* [Invoice](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/) — Fill, download INVOICE PDF.
* [Estimate](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/estimate) — ESTIMATE stamp, Valid until, not a tax invoice.

## Guides

* [How it works](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/how-to) — Client-side PDF.

* [Tax & discount](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/tax) — Math in the tab, not tax software.
* [iPhone](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/iphone) — Files holds the PDF.
* [Use cases](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/use-cases) — Freelancer, shop.
* [FAQ](https://nota-invoice-mu.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy.

## Not on this origin

* Bytes stay in the tab. There is no conversion API and no `/blogs/` cluster.
* No `/quote` `/receipt` `/tools`.
